source: GtRNAdb (UCSC Lowe Lab), Danio rerio tRNA gene set
build: tRNAscan-SE 2.0 genomic tRNA gene set from danRer11-tRNAs.fa (the per-genome primary/confidence-set FASTA, the same kind of file as the human hg38-tRNAs.fa used for the shipped homo_sapiens table -- verified: this build logic reproduces the shipped human 431-gene/47-anticodon table byte-identically). SeC (selenocysteine, TCA), Sup (suppressor), and Undet (undetermined isotype, NNN anticodon) excluded by isotype; non-ACGT anticodons excluded; initiator + elongator Met merged at CAT (automatic when counting per anticodon). 8879 gene records in source FASTA -> 8846 kept after excluding 3 SeC, 25 Sup, 5 Undet/NNN. Independently re-counted from a sha256-pinned FASTA (awk cross-check) with zero mismatches vs the TSV. Source FASTA URL https://gtrnadb.ucsc.edu/genomes/eukaryota/Dreri11/danRer11-tRNAs.fa (1747886 bytes), FASTA sha256 e81e605548df44e88ca0c3778b315202bd826c377ed9173e1a8575e21eb4090a.
genome: GRCz11 / danRer11 (nuclear genomic tRNAscan-SE set, primary chromosomes plus alt/scaffold contigs; no mitochondrial tRNAs)
note: Real tRNA gene copy numbers by anticodon (57 distinct anticodons; Danio rerio has a large teleost tRNA-gene expansion, hence far more genes than human). tAI relative adaptiveness is derived via the dos Reis et al. (2004) wobble model (optimised s-values, sking=0 eukaryote) as in the tai R package; see bt4.biomodels.codon.tai. Reproducible from this file's SHA-256. GtRNAdb publishes no explicit data license on its pages; cite Chan & Lowe, Nucleic Acids Research, GtRNAdb 2.0 (2016) doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1309 and GtRNAdb (2009) doi:10.1093/nar/gkn787. SCRATCHPAD STAGING ARTIFACT: not yet wired into the package; a future tAI wave must move it under src/bt4/biomodels/codon/data/ and add danio_rerio to available_tai_organisms. Source database: GtRNAdb (Chan & Lowe, Nucleic Acids Res 2016, doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1309), predictions by tRNAscan-SE 2.0 (Chan et al. 2021, doi:10.1093/nar/gkab688).
